test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Our rivals must have spread this rumour.

options.text: This rumour must have been spread by our rivals.
This rumour must be spread by our rivals.
This rumour may have been spread by our rivals.
This rumour has been spread by our rivals.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In converting from** active to passive** voice, the **object of the active** sentence becomes the **subject of the passive sentence.**
 
• The tense remains the same, but the form changes to fit the** passive voice structure.**
 
• The subject of the **active sentence (our rivals)** becomes the agent in the passive sentence, introduced by **'by'.**
 
• Since the **active sentence** is in perfect modal form "**must have spread**", the passive form will be "**must have been spread".**
 
• This ensures that the action is shown to have been done by someone else, specifically our rivals.

Hence, the correct statement is **'*This rumour must have been spread by our rivals.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Using the passive voice shifts the focus from the subject **(doer**) to the action or the object of the action.
 
• This can be useful for emphasizing the action or its recipient over the performer.
 
• In this case, the focus is on the spread of the rumour rather than who specifically spread it.
